title: Bitcoin defeats the Tower of Babel
summary: This episode delves into the origins of Babylon going back to the Tower of Babel, how decentralization was the solution then and now, and how Bitcoin’s design aligns with God’s methods to limit centralized control structures. It includes a fascinating survey of many related present-day issues and how Bitcoin and the Bible address them.
